title: Nonadaptive quadratic linear PCPP system
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a Boolean-proof proximity proof checking system for Boolean inputs of length $n$ and proofs of length $n+2(n+1)$, using three nonadaptive queries. Its seed is drawn uniformly from the endpoint and position-check seeds: endpoint seeds query the relevant single proof bit, while position seeds query the input and proof bits needed for the selected transition check. The verifier accepts according to the corresponding endpoint or transition condition on the returned answers; any unused query positions are left unanswered.
caveat: The formal statement depends on auxiliary proof-index and prefix-bit functions whose definitions are not included in the supplied material.
